checkedAlternates.risk: Lightning rods protect against massive lightning surges.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A lightning rod channels strike current directly to earth (group-4), whereas an MOV clamps voltage transients inside circuits (group-1).

checkedAlternates.risk: Thermal cutoff fuses trip on heat like thermal-magnetic breakers.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A thermal cutoff melts open permanently once triggered (group-2), unlike resettable circuit breakers (group-3).
